title: The soul is the essential part of a person

statements.text: A person is a soul plus whatever brain and body it is connected to. The soul's survival is necessary and sufficient for the person's survival, whatever happens to any physical part. Because "I" is an informative designator, a priori reflection shows that one's existence does not involve one's body, so each person is a pure mental substance, with a thisness that makes it the soul it is apart from its mental properties.

sources.quote: So my soul is the essential part of me - its survival is necessary and sufficient for me to survive.
I am therefore a pure mental substance, essentially a soul.
